title: Christmas bookings are open at The Anchor
preheader: Christmas dinner 10 November to 20 December, and lunch is back from midday, Tuesday to Friday.

image.alt: A table laid for Christmas dinner at The Anchor

data.headline: Christmas at The Anchor is open for bookings
body: We serve Christmas dinner from 10 November to 20 December 2026. A village pub rather than a hotel function room, so your group gets its own table and its own evening. Never a shared sitting with strangers.
Everyone picks their own courses, so nobody is tied to what the rest of the table is having.

rows.label: Sittings
rows.value: Tuesday to Saturday, plus Sunday 1pm to 6pm. No Mondays

rows.label: Group size
rows.value: 6 guests or more. Over 20 becomes private hire

rows.label: Deposit
rows.value: £10 per person, taken off your bill

data.footnote: Every adult gets a glass of prosecco, swappable for orange juice. Weekday and weekend prices differ, and pre-orders come to us 7 days before your date. Festive buffets are available for 30 guests or more.

data.text: December Fridays and Saturdays go first.

data.heading: We are open from lunchtime again
data.body: Lunch is back on the menu. From Tuesday 1 September we are serving from midday, so a proper sit-down lunch is seven minutes from Terminal 5 again.

image.alt: Lunch served at The Anchor near Heathrow

data.heading: Kitchen hours, Tuesday to Friday
data.note: The kitchen is closed on Mondays.

data.body: Tell us your date and rough numbers and we will come back to you within 24 hours.

data.ps_body: Pre-orders are due 7 days before your date, so the earlier it is locked in, the easier it is on everyone.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you enquired about a booking or an event with us, or because you may be close to us and we thought this information would be helpful to you.
